text: ポケモンを　いれかえた　だけでも　こっちの　ばんは　おわってしまうよ　さあ　こんどは　むこうの　ばんだぞ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　いれかえた　だけでも
こっちの　ばんは　おわってしまうよ
structure.en: our turn ends up being over

structure.jp: さあ　こんどは　むこうの　ばんだぞ！
structure.en: now, this time it's the other side's turn!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: しまう after a て-form verb says the thing happens completely, often when you would rather it didn't. おわってしまう = 'ends up being over'.

patterns.name: 〜だけでも
patterns.span: いれかえた　だけでも
patterns.explanation: だけ is 'just' and でも is 'even', so together they mean 'even just doing this'. いれかえた　だけでも = 'even if you just switched'.
